question: What did Benjamin Franklin change about making music with rubbed glasses?
answer: He set the glasses spinning. Franklin's 1761 armonica nested graded glass bowls on one rod turned by a treadle, so wet fingers could touch several at once and play chords. Rows of water-tuned wine glasses allowed a note or two at a time. His bowls were tuned by grinding, not by filling.
move: Rearranging the same parts can open moves the old layout forbade.
reference: Franklin, letter to Giambatista Beccaria, 13 July 1762, in The Papers of Benjamin Franklin, vol. 10, Yale University Press, 1966
